listTalks.title: A plan is not a program
listTalks.speaker: Ada Okonjo
listTalks.abstract: What you get back when the thing your server reads is data rather than code: one artifact you can diff, hash and explain before a request arrives.

listTalks.title: Loaders that refuse to waterfall
listTalks.speaker: Bea Lindqvist
listTalks.abstract: Two reads that do not depend on each other should leave together. Making that structural instead of a thing each author remembers to arrange.

listTalks.title: The backend is down and the page is fine
listTalks.speaker: Cai Deng
listTalks.abstract: Degrading one segment rather than the document, and what has to be true of your boundaries for that to be the default rather than a heroic afternoon.

listTalks.title: Caching is a contract, not a middleware
listTalks.speaker: Dara Whelan
listTalks.abstract: Putting the policy on the method that reads, beside the tags the writers drop, so a stale page is a spelling mistake somebody can grep for.

listTalks.title: Hydration you asked for
listTalks.speaker: Esen Yilmaz
listTalks.abstract: Per island rather than per page: what ships on load, what waits for the viewport and how to tell which of the two you actually wanted.

listTalks.title: Sessions without a database
listTalks.speaker: Fen Marlowe
listTalks.abstract: Everything a signed cookie can hold, everything it must not, and the shape of a schema that makes the difference checkable.

Coffee is out on the mezzanine until half past.
